title: Strawberry, Ginger, and Mint Sekanjabin
description: Based on an ancient Persian recipe, this drink syrup (sekanjabin) with strawberry, ginger, and mint keeps virtually indefinitely without special care.
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh or frozen strawberries, chopped
1 cup white balsamic vinegar (not distilled vinegar)

steps.text: Bring sugar and water to a boil in a large pot over high heat; boil until sugar has dissolved. Stir in strawberries, mint, ginger, lemon peels, and lemon juice; return to a boil. Reduce heat to medium; simmer for 20 minutes. Off heat, stir in vinegar. Set syrup aside at room temperature for 8 hours to overnight.
Strain mixture through a fine-mesh sieve; discard or reserve solids. Store syrup at room temperature in a sterile container.
Stir 1 part syrup into 4 to 6 parts water; serve cold with ice if desired.
